name: Exp_SilverTrend_Duplex
summary: This EA implements the SilverTrend signal indicator as a duplex trading system, generating buy and sell signals based on a combination of high/low price channel analysis with ATR-based volatility filtering. It opens positions in the direction of the detected trend breakout and closes them on opposing signals or stop conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了SilverTrend信号指标的双向交易系统，通过高低价通道分析与ATR波动率过滤相结合来生成买卖信号。它在检测到趋势突破方向开仓，并在反向信号或止损条件出现时平仓。
strategy_analysis: SilverTrend Duplex策略的核心概念是基于价格通道突破的趋势跟踪方法，利用一定周期内的最高价和最低价构建动态通道边界。入场条件为：当价格突破通道上轨时产生买入信号，当价格突破通道下轨时产生卖出信号，同时结合ATR指标作为波动率过滤器来确认突破的有效性，避免在窄幅震荡中频繁开仓。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓、固定止损止盈以及可选的追踪止损。仓位管理方面，支持固定手数交易，部分版本支持基于账户余额的比例仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA依赖止损来控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体投资组合层面的风险控制机制，如最大同时持仓限制或每日最大亏损限制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the SilverTrend Duplex strategy is a trend-following approach based on price channel breakouts, constructing dynamic channel boundaries using the highest high and lowest low over a specified lookback period. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when price breaks above the upper channel boundary, and a sell signal is generated when price breaks below the lower channel boundary, with the ATR indicator serving as a volatility filter to confirm breakout validity and prevent frequent entries during narrow consolidation ranges. Exit conditions include closing positions on opposing signals, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and optional trailing stop functionality. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions incorporating balance-based proportional lot calculation. Money management relies on stop-losses to control per-trade risk, but lacks portfolio-level risk controls such as maximum concurrent position limits or daily maximum drawdown restrictions.

parameters.name: SSP
parameters.description: 通道计算周期数，用于确定高低价范围
parameters.description_en: Channel calculation period for high-low range

parameters.name: Kmax
parameters.description: ATR通道宽度系数，控制通道扩展程度

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不使用固定止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不使用固定止盈
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不使用追踪止损
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 信号计算时间框架，0为当前周期

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于通道突破的趋势跟踪方法经典可靠
ATR波动率过滤有效减少震荡行情中的假信号和频繁交易
双向交易设计可同时捕捉上涨和下跌趋势，提高市场适应性
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on the classic and reliable channel breakout trend-following method
ATR volatility filter effectively reduces false signals and frequent trading during ranging markets
Duplex trading design captures both uptrend and downtrend opportunities, improving market adaptability
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损，缺乏市场状态识别机制
默认止损止盈为零，未设置止损的情况下风险敞口极大
缺乏仓位管理和资金管理的高级功能，如动态仓位调整和最大回撤控制
cons_en: Trend-following strategies prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets, lacking market regime detection
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, creating extreme risk exposure without protective stops
Lacks advanced position sizing and money management features such as dynamic lot adjustment and maximum drawdown control
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率阈值），在震荡行情中暂停交易以减少假信号亏损
添加强制止损机制和基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，替代零默认值，提升风险可控性
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (such as ADX or volatility threshold) to pause trading during ranging conditions and reduce false signal losses
Implement mandatory stop-loss with ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation instead of zero defaults to improve risk controllability

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，交易无保护性止损，单笔亏损可能极大
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
无持仓数量限制和每日亏损限制，极端行情下可能持续加仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, trades execute without protective stops, potentially resulting in extreme per-trade losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions on the same signal
No position count limit or daily loss limit, may continue adding positions during extreme market conditions

summary_en: This EA implements the SilverTrend signal indicator as a duplex trading system, generating buy and sell signals based on a combination of high/low price channel analysis with ATR-based volatility filtering. It opens positions in the direction of the detected trend breakout and closes them on opposing signals or stop conditions.
